page.layout: One page of running text, set in one column. Running head at the top, page number at the top left. Catchword at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Impietatis istius hinc vel præcipuè perpetua caussa est, quòd fidem Apostolicam septuplo proferentes, ipsi tamen fidem Euangelicam nolunt confiteri, dum in populis impietates suas multiloquiis defendunt, & magniloquen-tiæ vanitate aures simplicium verbis fallenti-bus illudunt, dum euitant domino de Christo ea credere quæ de se docuit credenda: & per speciosum pacis nomen in vnitatem perfidiæ subrepunt, & sub reiiciendis nouitatibus rur-sum ipsi novis ad Deum vocibus rebellant, & sub Scripturarum vocabulo non scripta menti-untur. &c. lib. 3. ad eundem.

Ipsi[?] sibi ipsis inter loquendum substratis quæ-cunq; voluerunt, & iis quæ inde consequun-tur assumptis, seipsos postea in cogitationes absurdas[?] detrudentes, hinc sese demonstrasse putant, sua placita necessario recipienda. Basi-lius Magnus, lib. 1. aduerf. Eunom.
Quoties isti perperam aliquid dicere aggre-diuntur, assumere solent initio nonnulla ab o-mnibus concessa, vt ex eo quod behe[?] in iis sen-tiunt, fides etiam ipsis in ceteris habeatur: Eodem lib. 1.

page.notes: Printer's ornament (fleuron) between C. and the catchword, not transcribed. Doubtful readings marked [?]: "Ipsi" (partly hidden by "sibi"), "absurdas" (letters partly broken), "behe" (possibly "bene"). The long s in "caussa" and "septuplo" follows the printed ff/l forms as read.
